seo.title: 6-Day Morocco Tour from Casablanca | Chefchaouen, Fes & Desert (2026)
seo.metaDescription: From €590 pp. 6-day Morocco tour from Casablanca to Marrakech (private 4x4 or shared). Hassan II Mosque, Chefchaouen, Fes medina & Erg Chebbi Sahara camp.
seo.lead: This six-day route connects Morocco's Atlantic coast, the Rif Mountains, two imperial capitals, and the Sahara Desert. Starting in Casablanca with a stop at the oceanfront Hassan II Mosque, you head north through Rabat before climbing into the blue-washed streets of Chefchaouen. From the mountains, the road leads past the Roman ruins of Volubilis and the monumental gates of Meknes into Fes for a full-day guided medina tour, then crosses the Middle Atlas and Ziz Valley down to Merzouga for a camel trek and desert camp overnight before traveling west through Todra Gorges, Dades Valley, and Ait Ben Haddou to Marrakech.
secondaryKeywords: Morocco tour with Chefchaouen and desert

price.label: From EUR 590 per person
price.note: Includes private A/C vehicle with driver-guide, 4 nights in boutique riads/hotels (1 night Chefchaouen, 2 nights Fes, 1 night Dades Valley), 1 night in an Erg Chebbi desert camp, a full-day licensed guide in Fes, camel rides, dinners in the desert and Dades, and daily breakfasts from Day 2.

faqs.question: Can you pick us up directly from Casablanca Airport (CMN)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Your driver will meet you in the arrivals hall at Mohammed V Airport with a name sign, or pick you up from your Casablanca hotel at your preferred time.

faqs.question: Is a local guide included in Fes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Because Fes el-Bali has over 9,000 narrow alleys, a licensed historical guide accompanies you for the day so you don't get lost and get the full context behind the monuments.

faqs.question: Which day has the longest drive?
faqs.answer: Day 4 (Fes to Merzouga) is the longest leg at around 7 hours of driving, broken up with stops in Ifrane, the Azrou monkey forest, Midelt for lunch, and viewpoints over the Ziz Valley.

faqs.question: What accommodations are included?
faqs.answer: You stay 1 night in Chefchaouen, 2 nights in Fes, 1 night in a Merzouga desert camp, and 1 night in Dades Valley. Luxury camp upgrades with private bathrooms and climate control are available.

faqs.question: Can we customize this route?
faqs.answer: Yes. Since this is a private tour, we can easily add a night in Essaouira at the end or adjust the pace to fit your flight schedule.
